confirmed_findings.statement: Binance states it has replenished 90% of the stolen asset value and that BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC are each 100% backed.
Binance says the remaining 10% consists of tokens outside the top ten and is less liquid; the statement does not identify an XRP-specific outstanding purchase requirement.
Lookonchain reports 7,500 BTC moved from the Binance SAFU fund to a new wallet; Arkham shows approximately 7.5K BTC remaining in the labeled source wallet.
XRP Insights reports 22.48B XRP across 701 wallets attributed to 24 exchanges at October 31 08:00 UTC; Binance 2.78B, Coinbase 5.85B and Upbit 6.43B.

disconfirming_evidence: BitInfoCharts still displays 15,000 BTC for the SAFU source address, but its last transaction marker is August 9 and its direct page fetch failed; it is retained as a stale conflicting observation, not preferred over the newer Arkham/Lookonchain evidence.
The XRP Insights same-wallet daily series rebounded +105.9M on October 31 after -207.3M on October 30.
XRP Insights reports Binance-attributed wallets +17.6M over seven days and +30.3M over 30 days; this weakens a persistent 220M XRP reserve-depletion narrative.

XRP Insights' exchange totals include cold storage, customer omnibus balances, 327.4M Binance-Peg backing reserve, 150.2M cbXRP backing reserve and 11.2M insurance/charity wallets; they are not tradable float.

market_observation.methodology: Daily rippled account_info balances for tracked XRPL accounts; XRPSCAN public labels; same-wallet comparisons.

funding_sources: excess Futures Insurance Fund balance above required regulatory level
binance_recovery.xrp_specific_purchase_quantity: UNKNOWN; update says XRP is already 100% backed in the top-ten set

safu_transfer.interpretation: POSSIBLE_PARTIAL_SAFU_DEPLOYMENT_OR_INTERNAL_CUSTODY_REALLOCATION; NOT PROVEN MARKET SALE OR XRP PURCHASE
safu_transfer.source_conflict: BitInfoCharts stale page still reports 15,000 BTC; Arkham and Lookonchain newer observations support 7,500 BTC remaining/moved.

causal_assessment.assessment: WEAKENED_BY_XRP_INSIGHTS_SAME_WALLET_REBOUND_AND_BINANCE_7D_30D_POSITIVE_CHANGES; DIFFERENT PROVIDER WALLET UNIVERSES REMAIN UNRECONCILED
causal_assessment.next_test: Crosswalk CryptoQuant/XRP Insights sets against Binance official PoR addresses and repeat after the full Nov 3 proof.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The 7,500 BTC transfer is part of Binance's partial SAFU deployment associated with the incident recovery.
support: Binance announced partial SAFU deployment within the recovery program.
Lookonchain reported 7,500 BTC moved from the SAFU fund; Arkham showed 7.5K BTC remaining at the labeled source wallet.
disconfirming: The readable tracker post does not expose the destination or transaction hash.
The transfer could be a custody migration or internal treasury reallocation rather than a sale or token purchase.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Obtain the transaction hash and destination wallet; inspect subsequent transfers, exchange deposits, OTC labels and token swaps.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The 7,500 BTC transfer is an internal custody/treasury reallocation and not evidence of a BTC sale or purchase of recovery assets.
support: Arkham shows 7.5K BTC remaining at the source and Lookonchain says the amount went to a new wallet.
No public transaction-level evidence in the captured sources shows BTC sold or converted.
disconfirming: Binance explicitly says partial SAFU deployment is part of recovery, and the timing is consistent with that announcement.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Trace destination wallet and any subsequent market/OTC settlement.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The previously inferred approximately 220M XRP Binance reserve drawdown is not a persistent same-wallet depletion and should not be treated as bullish exchange outflow or proof of theft-driven reserve replacement.
support: XRP Insights reports +105.9M all-exchange same-wallet change on Oct 31 after -207.3M on Oct 30.
Its Binance-attributed wallets show +17.6M over seven days and +30.3M over 30 days, with 2.78B XRP on Oct 31.
disconfirming: XRP Insights and CryptoQuant use different wallet universes and time windows.
The broad XRP Insights totals include cold storage, customer balances and 487.2M in wrapped/operational reserves; they are not tradable float.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Crosswalk CryptoQuant and XRP Insights wallet sets against official Binance PoR addresses and repeat the comparison after the full Nov 3 proof.

forecast.reason: No calibrated walk-forward model; reserve event is not a verified directional feature.

safety: Public, read-only evidence only. No account access, wallet interaction, transaction, purchase, secret access, workflow dispatch, merge, deployment or real-money trade.
